title: funstory-ai/BabelDOC: layout-preserving translation for research PDFs
friendlyTitle: BabelDOC translates research papers and keeps their layout
summary: BabelDOC is an AGPL-licensed Python library for translating scientific PDFs while supporting bilingual comparison and preserving document structure. The actively maintained project offers a command-line interface and Python API and currently shows about 9,200 stars.
friendlySummary: BabelDOC is a popular open-source tool for translating PDF research papers while keeping the document easier to compare with the original.
whyItMatters: Researchers and developers can translate technical papers, embed document translation in another application or connect the workflow to Zotero through related tools. Users should check equations, specialist terms and confidential documents before relying on an external translation service.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to read papers in another language or add translation to an app. Check technical words, formulas and private documents carefully.
